# Go Mode Service Discovery API Reference

<!-- Code generated by gen-api-sdk; DO NOT EDIT. -->

Service-neutral JSON discovery manifest served publicly at `/.well-known/gomode.json` for Go Mode Android bootstrap. Clients must only accept `apiVersion` values they explicitly support and must require `webShell.bridgeVersion` to match the native bridge they implement.

Type notation: `JSONValue` means any valid JSON value.

## Settings

| Method | Path | Description | Request | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|---------|----------|
| GET | `/.well-known/gomode.json` | Returns Go Mode service compatibility settings. |  | `Settings` |

## Errors

All errors return:

```json
{
  "error": { "code": "<CODE>", "message": "..." },
  "details": { ... }
}
```

|------|------|

## Types

### ToolGroup

ToolGroup describes a bootstrap MCP tool group advertised by the manifest.

A tool group is the compatibility manifest's compact view of a Go Mode skill.
The authoritative context, activation hints, and tool subset live in the
skill's SKILL.md frontmatter; the manifest stays small so clients can decide
whether native features are compatible before loading skill files.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` |  | yes |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `endpoint` | `string` |  | yes |
| `protocolVersion` | `string` | ProtocolVersion is the MCP protocol version spoken by this group endpoint.
The shell sends it on MCP requests so each group can be checked and
upgraded independently during protocol migrations. | yes |
| `authRequired` | `boolean` |  | yes |
| `skillUrl` | `string` | SkillURL points to the SKILL.md file whose frontmatter defines activation,
instructions, and the MCP tool subset for this skill. |  |

### LocationWiFi

LocationWiFi matches any one of the configured Wi-Fi SSIDs.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `ssids` | `string[]` | SSIDs are Wi-Fi network names that can activate the skill. |  |

### PhysicalPosition

PhysicalPosition matches a named latitude and longitude within RadiusMeters.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` | Name is a user-facing label for this physical position. | yes |
| `latitude` | `float64` |  | yes |
| `longitude` | `float64` |  | yes |
| `radiusMeters` | `float64` | RadiusMeters is the activation radius around the latitude and longitude. | yes |

### LocationActivation

LocationActivation groups one location-based activation signal for a skill.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `wifi` | `LocationWiFi` |  |  |
| `physicalPosition` | `PhysicalPosition` |  |  |

### SkillActivation

SkillActivation carries hints the shell matches against current context to
decide when to load a skill. Matching is on-device: the service never receives
the user's context or location just because a skill was considered.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `locations` | `LocationActivation[]` | Locations are local physical-location and Wi-Fi hints that make this skill
an activation candidate. |  |

### SkillMCPServer

SkillMCPServer declares which tools from an MCP endpoint belong to one skill.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` |  | yes |
| `endpoint` | `string` |  | yes |
| `protocolVersion` | `string` | ProtocolVersion is the MCP protocol version spoken by this endpoint. | yes |
| `authRequired` | `boolean` |  | yes |
| `tools` | `string[]` | Tools is the explicit allowlist of MCP tool names activated by the skill. | yes |

### SkillGoMode

SkillGoMode contains Go Mode-specific SKILL.md frontmatter fields.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `activation` | `SkillActivation` |  |  |
| `mcpServers` | `SkillMCPServer[]` |  | yes |

### SkillFrontmatter

SkillFrontmatter is the YAML frontmatter schema for a Go Mode SKILL.md file.

The Markdown body carries human and model instructions. The frontmatter carries
machine-readable activation hints and the MCP tool allowlist that the native
shell can register when the skill becomes active.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` |  | yes |
| `description` | `string` |  | yes |
| `gomode` | `SkillGoMode` |  | yes |
